title: Navigation menu with sub-menus, menu items and a workspace tile
instruction: Create a navigation menu named ConFleet labeled @FLM540 with a Vehicles sub-menu (label @FLM95) holding the FMVehicle list page, a Setup sub-menu holding FMSetup, and a Workspaces sub-menu holding the FMClerkWorkspace tile. The list pages open in the content area. Use only the d365fo CLI — do not hand-write XML.
